title: SC Wharf - Water Collection Protocol
author: Kendra Negrey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rrgd53w

steps.title: Collect Whole Water Sample
steps.instruction: Collect whole water samples at multiple depths using a FieldMaster student sampler.

substeps.instruction: Mix the collected water together in a 4L bottle.

steps.title: Perform Net Tow Collection
steps.instruction: Collect a plankton sample using a plankton net with 20um mesh and a 300mL cod end.

substeps.instruction: Drop the net to 10ft and slowly pull it up to the surface.
Repeat the drop and pull process 5 times (total vertical effort = 50 ft).
Reduce the final remaining volume to 300mL and pour into a bottle.

steps.title: Transport Samples to Lab
steps.instruction: Transport all collected water samples back to the lab for further processing (e.g., cell counts, nutrients, chl a, toxins, pigments, bacteria, and phytoplankton observations).
